subject: Finexa references: rotation, declines, and substitutes
messages:
From: Sophia Torres <sophia.torres@finexa.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for customer references for vendor review

Hi Lauren / Marcus,

We’re starting our vendor reference checks as part of Finexa’s evaluation. Procurement asked for three live customer references who have gone to production in the last 12 months and one short case study or testimonial if available. Two asks: (1) would Redwood be able to provide three references, and (2) if any of your references recently asked to be rotated off lists (reference fatigue), can you propose substitutes and a cadence for future reference requests so we don’t overburden customers?

Timeline: procurement would like references by Monday, 9 Mar. Thanks — happy to hop on a short call.

Best,
Sophia
Sophia Torres
Senior Vendor Ops, Finexa Capital

Attachment: RFP_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Torres <sophia.torres@finexa.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for customer references for vendor review

Hi Sophia — thanks for the heads-up. We can provide references but wanted to flag two things up front: (a) a couple of our production customers have recently been on short lists for multiple vendors and asked to pause reference calls (we respect that), and (b) we usually rotate our reference pool monthly and keep a standby list of willing substitutes.

Quick proposal to hit your timeline:
- Primary list (3): AcornPay (POC + production, CS: Monica Patel), BrightDocs (prod, short testimonial), HelixBank (prod, 6mo)
- Standby substitutes (if any primary declines): OrionAnalytics, Mesa Financial
- Cadence: we recommend a 6–8 week cool-down for high-touch customers after a reference call; lower-touch customers can be re-requested after 4 weeks.

I’ll loop Monica for availability and consent and can send a one-page consent/template and intake note for each ref.

Regards,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: reference_rotation_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sophia Torres <sophia.torres@finexa.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for customer references for vendor review

Adding two operational notes from my side:
1) Consent: we need verbal or written consent from each reference before sharing their contact info (SOC + privacy). Monica — can you confirm which of the three are OK?
2) Prepared substitutes: for procurement-heavy processes we often offer a quick substitute call (15 min) with a solutions engineer rather than a full customer interview — lowers friction.

If Finexa prefers, we can provide a short recorded testimonial clip from BrightDocs instead of a live call.

-Marcus
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for customer references for vendor review

Lauren / Marcus — I checked with the CS owners at AcornPay and BrightDocs. Quick status:
- AcornPay: available for a 30-min intro call next Tue or Wed; comfortable sharing a short case blurb.
- BrightDocs: happy to provide a recorded 2–3 min testimonial and a single 15-min Q&A with product team; would prefer not to take a full procurement panel.
- HelixBank: asked to be excluded this quarter due to audit cycle (reference fatigue) — they requested a 3-month pause.

Given HelixBank’s pause, I recommend using OrionAnalytics as a live substitute (they did a production migration last quarter and are CS-managed by me).

I’ve attached the consent form and a one-pager we can send to Sophia to speed sign-off.

-Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: reference_consent_form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for customer references for vendor review

Looping in a quick policy note so we stay consistent across deals:
- If a customer explicitly requests a pause (like HelixBank), honor the pause and set a calendar reminder for outreach post-pause. Don’t add them back to auto-rotation until we confirm.
- Offer substitutions proactively when a high-value reference declines; preference order: internal standby -> recorded testimonial -> SE-hosted call.
- For enterprise RFPs, we prefer to provide 2 live references + 1 recorded/testimonial to reduce fatigue.

Lauren: approve the final list and share the consent docs with Sophia. If procurement insists on HelixBank specifically, escalate to me and I’ll handle the ask directly.

Thanks,
Rachel
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Torres <sophia.torres@finexa.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for customer references for vendor review

Hi Sophia — thanks for the patience. Final plan below to meet Finexa’s procurement timeline:

Final references (2 live + 1 recorded):
- AcornPay — 30-min live call (Mon/Wed availability next week) — CS: Monica Patel (consent confirmed)
- OrionAnalytics — 20-min live call (standby substitute for HelixBank) — CS: Monica Patel
- BrightDocs — recorded 2–3 min testimonial + 15-min Q&A with product (recording attached)

We’ve attached a short consent form for each reference to sign electronically. If procurement still needs HelixBank specifically, please let us know and we’ll escalate per Rachel’s note.

Regards,
